Method of Attack: Uses GitHub to secure its command-and-control infrastructure
Uses a technique known as dead drop resolver to determine its command-and-control (C2) server
Executes commands received from a remote server
Impacted Systems: Networks of several local governments in the United States
Attack Vector: Compromise of a VMware Horizon server using two Log4j vulnerabilities (CVE-2021-44228 and CVE-2021-45046)
Delivery of the Drokbk binary by means of a compressed ZIP archive hosted on a file transfer service
